cleanCoreLevels.A: Cleanest: built on-stack with the ABAP Cloud development model, or side-by-side on SAP BTP (ABAP Cloud, CAP, low-code/no-code), using only released APIs (or wrappers).
cleanCoreLevels.B: Classic ABAP development using classic SAP APIs per SAP's recommendations for classic technologies/frameworks (ATC Priority 3 / info).
cleanCoreLevels.C: Cannot qualify for Level B because it uses arbitrary SAP-internal objects; conditionally clean only if changelog-for-SAP-objects checks run before every upgrade (ATC Priority 2 / warning).
cleanCoreLevels.D: Not clean core: modifications, not-recommended SAP objects, or not-recommended extension technologies such as implicit enhancements (ATC Priority 1 / error).

releaseContracts.C0: Extend — stability at defined extension points for objects enhanced via ABAP Dictionary / ABAP CDS enhancement tools.
releaseContracts.C1: Use System-Internally — technically stable public interface for system-internal use across ABAP language versions; the actual gate for "released for use in ABAP Cloud / cloud development".
releaseContracts.C2: Use as Remote API — like C1, plus guarantees external/remote consumers need no adjustment after an upgrade.
releaseContracts.C3: Manage Configuration Content — stable persistence for own configuration content, exportable/importable/editable via dedicated APIs, for Business Configuration Tools.
